sri-sri-ravi-shankar: Born 13 May 1956 Papanasam; parents; naming; Sudhakar Chaturvedi; physics St Joseph's 1973; Maharishi from mid-1970s; 1982 Bhadra/Shimoga; AoL 1981; first courses Switzerland 1983, Apple Valley 1986; ECOSOC 1996; FARC Havana 2015; Iraq 2007-08, 2014; Ayodhya panel March 2019; Padma Vibhushan 2016; 2012 Naxalism and 2018 Syria remarks; bloggers suit -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ravi_Shankar_(spiritual_leader)
'like a poem, an inspiration' -> Ashok Mahadevan, Reader's Digest, Feb 2007, as cited in Wikipedia (not seen directly)
'During a ten-day period of silence, the SudarshanKriya came like an inspiration' -> https://www.artofliving.org/at-en/origin-sudarshan-kriya
370 million in 180 countries; IAHV 1997; Gita at four; fasting (French page) -> https://www.artofliving.org/cy-el/biography-sri-sri-ravi-shankar
Yale trial N=131, arms 47/29/21/34, SKY largest gains -> https://public-pages-files-2025.frontiersin.org/journals/psychiatry/articles/10.3389/fpsyt.2020.00590/text
BMJ Open 2022: 85 randomised, 59 completed, non-inferior on PCL, inferior on BDI-II and PANAS at 1 year -> https://bmjopen.bmj.com/content/12/8/e056609
FT 'Thoroughly modern godman', Chloe Cornish, 29 Oct 2022 -> https://www.proquest.com/docview/2740366287

NGT 7 Dec 2017: responsible, Rs 5 crore to DDA, recover excess, no further penalty, DDA contributory negligence -> https://www.livelaw.in/amp/ngt-holds-sri-sris-art-of-living-guilty-damaging-yamuna-floodplains-told-cough-restoration-cost-read-order

Expert committee: ~180 ha, >Rs 42 crore, >=10 years; AoL 'flawed, unscientific and biased'; two members unsigned -> https://www.downtoearth.org.in/news/environment/ngt-panel-claims-2016-event-ruined-yamuna-floodplains-art-of-living-calls-it-flawed-57583
'the Central and state governments and the NGT itself' -> https://www.pressreader.com/india/hindustan-times-delhi/20170419/281595240408005

SC 22 Aug 2026, Justices S.C. Sharma and N. Kotiswar Singh, Vyakti Vikas Kendra India v. Manoj Misra; refund in 4 weeks; DDA to continue rehabilitation -> https://www.livelaw.in/top-stories/supreme-court-sets-aside-ngt-order-holding-art-of-living-foundation-liable-for-yamuna-riverplain-damage-in-2016-546972

'of a sweeping nature'; 'damage, if any, cannot be attributed to the appellant'; 'to hold the event on an active floodplain of the river cannot be approved' -> https://theprint.in/india/yamuna-floodplain-sc-overturns-ngt-order-against-art-of-living-directs-refund-of-rs-5-crore-fine/3022437/
Bloggers suit filed Nov 2010, defamation dismissed June 2011, settled and dismissed with prejudice 2012 -> https://www.dmlp.org/taxonomy/term/59
ramdev: Birth name, Alipur, Mahendragarh, parents, birth year 1965-1975, Satyarth Prakash, Arsh Gurukul 1984-89, Kripalu Bagh, Karamveer, Divya Yog Mandir Trust 5 Jan 1995, Sanskar 2002, Aastha 2003, Patanjali 2006, Balkrishna majority/Ramdev no shares, Ramlila 2011, Modi 2014, Haryana 2015, 2013 homosexuality, Coronil, 'stupid science' 2021, Pranayama Rahasya 2009 (Diamond) -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ramdev

20 million daily viewers; 'Yoga is self-healing and self-realisation'; cancer testimonies; IMA president 'false hope'; Edamaruku and 1954 Act; 'the communists have an agenda' -> https://mg.co.za/article/2008-07-03-tv-swami-offers-a-cureall
